import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_N = 1 << 20;
    static final int MAX_M = 21;

    static int modPow(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (int) ((1L * result * base) % MOD);
            }
            base = (int) ((1L * base * base) % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int nVal;
    static int[] fArr = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] gArr = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[][] prob = new int[MAX_M][MAX_M];

    static int[][] indexTable = new int[2][MAX_N];
    static int[] reverseMap = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] matchedArr = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[][] adjacency = new int[MAX_M][MAX_M];

    static void process(int[] dst, List<Integer> left, List<Integer> right, List<Integer> subgraphs, int[] indexMap) {
        List<int[]> edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int u : left) {
            for (int v : right) {
                edgeList.add(new int[]{u, v});
            }
        }

        int edgeCount = edgeList.size();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << edgeCount); ++mask) {
            long weight = 1;
            int newMask = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; ++i) {
                int u = edgeList.get(i)[0], v = edgeList.get(i)[1];
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    weight = (weight * prob[u][v]) % MOD;
                    adjacency[u][v] = 1;
                } else {
                    weight = (weight * ((1 - prob[u][v] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    adjacency[u][v] = 0;
                }
            }

            for (int gr : subgraphs) {
                List<Integer> perm = new ArrayList<>(left);
                List<Integer> idxList = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < nVal; ++i) {
                    if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        idxList.add(i + nVal);
                    }
                }

                boolean found = false;
                Collections.sort(idxList);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < perm.size(); ++i) {
                        if (adjacency[perm.get(i)][idxList.get(i)] == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(idxList));

                if (found) {
                    newMask |= (1 << indexMap[gr]);
                }
            }

            dst[newMask] = (int) ((dst[newMask] + weight) % MOD);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> list) {
        int i = list.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && list.get(i) >= list.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = list.size() - 1;
        while (list.get(j) <= list.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(list, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(list.subList(i + 1, list.size()));
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        nVal = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < nVal; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < nVal; ++j) {
                int temp = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j + nVal] = (int) ((1L * temp * modPow(100, MOD - 2)) % MOD);
            }
        }

        if (nVal == 1) {
            System.out.println(prob[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int leftSize = nVal / 2;
        int rightSize = nVal - leftSize;

        int count1 = 0, count2 = 0;
        List<Integer> subset1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> subset2 = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << nVal); ++mask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == leftSize) {
                indexTable[0][mask] = count1++;
                subset1.add(mask);
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == rightSize) {
                indexTable[1][mask] = count2++;
                subset2.add(mask);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < count2; ++i) {
            int mask = subset2.get(i);
            int complement = ((1 << nVal) - 1) ^ mask;
            reverseMap[(1 << count2) - 1 - (1 << i)] |= (1 << indexTable[0][complement]);
        }

        List<Integer> leftPart1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> leftPart2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rightPart = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = nVal; i < 2 * nVal; ++i) {
            rightPart.add(i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < leftSize; ++i) {
            leftPart1.add(i);
        }
        for (int i = leftSize; i < nVal; ++i) {
            leftPart2.add(i);
        }

        process(fArr, leftPart1, rightPart, subset1, indexTable[0]);
        process(gArr, leftPart2, rightPart, subset2, indexTable[1]);

        int totalSubsets = 1 << count1;
        for (int i = 0; i < count1; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < totalSubsets; ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    fArr[mask] = (fArr[mask] + fArr[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        int totalSubsets2 = 1 << count2;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < totalSubsets2; ++mask) {
            int comp = totalSubsets2 - 1 - mask;
            int revMask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < count2; ++i) {
                if ((comp & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    revMask |= (1 << reverseMap[comp]);
                }
            }
            int invComp = totalSubsets - 1 - revMask;
            int weight = (1 - fArr[invComp] + MOD) % MOD;
            answer = (answer + 1L * weight * gArr[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
